An AI business assistant helps analyze information, organize knowledge, and support day-to-day decision-making across a business. It works with your documents, data, and goals to provide structured insights, recommendations, and next steps, so leaders spend less time gathering information and more time acting on it. Why choose an AI assistant for business? Because modern businesses generate more information than teams can process manually. An AI assistant for business reduces cognitive overload by connecting data, summarizing insights, and supporting execution - helping teams move faster without adding headcount or complexity. What’s the difference between an AI business agent and an AI assistant? An AI business assistant responds when asked, it helps answer questions, analyze data, or draft plans on demand. Is Buddy also an AI business consultant? Yes. Buddy functions as an AI business consultant by providing structured guidance, scenario analysis, and strategic input based on your specific business context. Unlike traditional consulting, guidance is continuous, contextual, and available whenever decisions need to be made. How is Buddy different from AI chatbots for business?
